The pole is heavily decorated with a dense cluster of vibrant, multi-colored ribbons (red, yellow, blue, green, purple) that appear to be swirling or knotted at the apex. The ribbons cascade downwards in thick, flowing strands. No dancers, base, or ground are visible due to the tight framing on the upper portion of the structure.
